label: candidate-functional
method: Real UI, keyboard and CDP touch input; captured main rAF with explicit complete WebGL frames. Functional assertions only; no FPS or performance claim.
fixtures: Fresh browser context, deterministic Math.random seed 417, initial manual quality and audience enabled in localStorage.
Google Fonts CSS is replaced with an empty response and browser system fallback fonts are used; font fidelity is outside this check.
The app main rAF is captured; other rAF callbacks, the UI and audio clock remain native. Each requested main frame really renders and readPixels completes its WebGL work.

Listener assertions compare the intended target pose. A baseline without the target cache records the original setListener inputs after calling it unchanged; interpolated AudioParam values are not treated as immediate targets.

Seat reachability: director.placeAt places the walker beside a real unoccupied seat, avoiding a long venue walk. Seat selection itself uses E or the touch sit button; standing uses E or the real walk button.
After the real sit input, director.update(2.5) finishes only the existing camera tween; the seated frame still renders normally.

Before the real 공연 시작 click, snapRoster places only the current score track/chair roster and snapConductor completes its conductor entrance. This avoids pending exits of unrelated players while main rAF is captured; the real runConcert waits, audio start and controls remain active.
For the selected Bach programme item, snapConductor(false) completes only the conductor exit animation; the programme selection and music start use real controls.

After the UI selects the world and seeks past the title, dome.update(8) advances the existing dome controller, including shader time and lighting, past the maximum 7-second startPiece reveal and live fade-out. It does not select a world, replace the shader, write transition uniforms directly or manually advance the audio clock.

domeVisibility.method: Read-only mesh.visible===true observation after the existing entry-button-ready wait and before first UI entry or requested main render. The UI-ready condition remains separate. No visibility assignment, compile call, render frame or audio mutation. This does not prove compile success or first-pixel readiness.

device.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 13; Pixel 7) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/153.0.8010.0 Mobile Safari/537.36

resumeTrace.method: Passive 100ms wall-clock samples; audio state/visibility listeners; one read-only engine.onTick observer. No manual frames or clock/audio mutations during the resume wait.

dome.input: programme button -> seek pointer -> play/pause button

audienceControl.limitation: The crowd slider itself is checked with keyboard events, including mobile emulation; joystick, view and seek touch checks remain separate.

automatic.note: Only the setting/reset path is checked here. Without an exact expectedPreset, desktop GPU classification is not independently checked. Adaptation and recovery are not demonstrated by synthetic functional cadence.

mobileSeekDiagnostics.method: Capture-only input listeners and a transparent perf.seek wrapper. Original touchStart/touchEnd, then the original immediate time read and a separate paused-position wait. No seek/clock substitution.

observation.note: Capture-phase defaultPrevented is read before target handlers. Observation adds overhead; event/seek evidence does not prove physical-device behaviour.
